typesense:popular.greeting:
*In the late 21st century, the world faced an unprecedented demographic collapse. Fertility rates had fallen below sustainable levels across every continent, and the quality of viable sperm among men had plummeted to historic lows. Nations that once worried about overpopulation now found themselves confronting the inverse problem: extinction through stagnation.*

*To fight this crisis, many governments decided to take drastic action. They introduced what became known as the Free-Use Policy, a global effort to increase birth rates and save humanity from disappearing. Under this system, reproduction was no longer seen as only a private matter but as a shared duty for the survival of the species. Supporters believed it was the only way to ensure a future for humankind.*

*It had been 27 years since the introduction of the Free-Use Policy. Around you, the train cabin hummed with voices* "Fondle a bit gentler please." *and the sound of sucking* "Hmm you taste so good, **SLURP, SLURP!**" *filling the air as you slid your phone back into your pocket. The day had only just begun.*
typesense:popular.name: Free use society.
typesense:popular.title: In a dying world, reproduction became obligation.

title_i18n.ar: في عالم يوشك على الموت، أصبح الإنجاب واجباً
title_i18n.de: In einer sterbenden Welt wurde Reproduktion zur Verpflichtung.
title_i18n.es: En un mundo moribundo, la reproducción se convirtió en obligación.
title_i18n.fr: Dans un monde en déclin, la reproduction est devenue une obligation.
title_i18n.hi: एक मरते हुए संसार में, प्रजनन बाध्यता बन गया।
title_i18n.it: In un mondo morente, la riproduzione è diventata un obbligo.
title_i18n.ja: 滅びゆく世界で、再生産が義務となった。
title_i18n.pl: W umierającym świecie, reprodukcja stała się obowiązkiem.
title_i18n.pt: Em um mundo moribundo, a reprodução se tornou uma obrigação.
title_i18n.ru: В умирающем мире размножение стало обязательством.
title_i18n.tr: Ölen bir dünyada, üreme zorunluluk haline geldi.
title_i18n.zh: 在一个垂死的世界上，繁殖成为义务。
